external_audit.opinion_detail: Ernst & Young disclaimed their opinion on the 2023/24 financial statements due to (i) the disclaimer of opinion on the prior year accounts, (ii) resource capacity of the finance team to support the audit, and (iii) limited time between backstop dates. EY explicitly stated they did not have the required resources available to complete the detailed audit procedures needed to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence to issue an unmodified audit report.
external_audit.governance_finding: Annual Governance Statement for 2023/24 was not available until November 2024 and therefore was not published alongside the draft financial statements, requiring the inspection period to be re-run to comply with Accounts and Audit Regulations 2015 - a procedural compliance failure
external_audit.pwlb_status: Council has no PWLB borrowings primarily for yield, nor plans for such borrowings (per 2021 Prudential Code update which prevents this)
external_audit.audit_2024_25_status: Audit Committee Annual Report for 2024/25 to be presented at Full Council meeting on 15 January 2026 - 2024/25 audit opinion not yet publicly available at research date

internal_audit.overall_opinion: not located - Audit Committee Annual Report 2024/25 to be presented to Full Council 15 January 2026
internal_audit.follow_up_required: Read Audit Committee Annual Report on portal.southtyneside.info CMIS after 15 January 2026

mtfs_2026_31.savings_strategy: Targeted efficiencies, service redesigns and income generation; streamlining Adult Social Care charging policies to ensure consistency and sustainability while protecting most vulnerable
mtfs_2026_31.reduction_focus: Management and back-office functions to protect frontline services

mtfs_2026_31.reserves_strategy_26_31: Efforts under way to maximise savings to start to build back reserves, reduce future service cuts and post reductions; MTFP sets a path back toward greater financial resilience

South Tyneside Homes Limited (council-owned ALMO, company 05381705): both accounts and confirmation statement currently overdue at Companies House (status active); application made to formally dissolve the registered company. ALMO manages 18,000 council homes.
strategic_risks.follow_up_required: Read Audit Committee strategic risk register on portal.southtyneside.info CMIS
strategic_risks.st_homes_clarification: The £270.5M overdue-accounts figure in companies_house_enrichment.json represents two ledger variants (SOUTH TYNESIDE HOMES LTD £170.04M + SOUTH TYNESIDE HOMES £100.43M) of the SAME company - the wholly-owned ALMO (company number 05381705). This is NOT two suppliers with overdue accounts; it is one ALMO whose statutory filings have lapsed. Per public-domain notice, an application has been made to formally dissolve the registered company - the ALMO function is being wound up / transferred back to direct council management.

lgr.context: South Tyneside is one of seven councils in the North East Combined Authority (NECA) which absorbed the previous combined authority on 6 March 2024 with deeper devolution deal. NECA is led by elected Mayor Kim McGuinness (first election 2 May 2024). At time of research, there are no plans for councils within NECA to undergo local government reorganisation.
